title: Agentic Analysis for Agentic Infrastructure: An LLM-Powered Pipeline for Comparative Governance of DAO and Corporate AI Protocols
description: Computational pipeline for a descriptive comparison of public ERC-8004 and A2A governance records: scraping, multi-model LLM annotation, discourse metrics, and social network analysis. This fork adds source-linked vector figures and reviewer navigation to the v1.1.1 computational package. A2A allows external contribution while initial formal voting is held by an eight-seat TSC. The accompanying dataset is hosted separately on Hugging Face (kl41r3/erc8004-vs-a2a-governance, CC BY-NC 4.0) under a pinned revision.
